SELECT ROUND((MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'SME' THEN total END) - MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'LAM' THEN total END))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "sme_minus_lam", ROUND((MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'LAM' THEN total END) - MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'KAM' THEN total END))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "lam_minus_kam", ROUND((MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'KAM' THEN total END) - MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'SME' THEN total END))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "kam_minus_sme" FROM (SELECT segment, total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY total ASC, customerid ASC) AS "rn" FROM (SELECT "c".segment, "c".customerid, SUM("y".consumption::NUMERIC) AS "total" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "c".currency = 'CZK' AND "c".segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') AND "y".date::INTEGER >= 201301 AND "y".date::INTEGER < 201401 GROUP BY "c".segment, "c".customerid) AS "totals") AS "ranked" WHERE rn = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT "di".account_id, (SELECT MAX(a11) - MIN(a11) FROM "district") AS "salary_difference" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "di" ON "di".client_id = "c".client_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "c".district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM "district" WHERE a11 = (SELECT MIN(a11) FROM "district")) AND "c".birth_date = (SELECT MIN("c2".birth_date) FROM "client" AS "c2" WHERE "c2".gender = 'F' AND "c2".district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM "district" WHERE a11 = (SELECT MIN(a11) FROM "district"))) LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".a2 AS "district", CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT) AS "population" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "a".date >= (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', MIN(date)) FROM "account") AND "a".date < (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', MIN(date)) + INTERVAL '1 month' FROM "account") AND CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT) = (SELECT MAX(CAST("d2".a4 AS BIGINT)) FROM "district" AS "d2" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a2" ON "a2".district_id = "d2".district_id WHERE "a2".date >= (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', MIN(date)) FROM "account") AND "a2".date < (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', MIN(date)) + INTERVAL '1 month' FROM "account")) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "d".account_id FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id WHERE "d".type = 'OWNER' AND "c".gender = 'M' AND "c".birth_date >= DATE '1974-01-01' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1977-01-01') AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".k_symbol IS NULL OR TRIM("t".k_symbol) = '' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", ROUND(COALESCE(SUM("l".amount), 0)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id), 0)) AS "average_active_loan_per_account" FROM (SELECT district_id, a2 FROM "district" ORDER BY a4::BIGINT DESC, district_id ASC LIMIT 5) AS "d" LEFT JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id AND "l".status IN ('C', 'D') GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2 ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM("l".amount), 0)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id), 0) DESC NULLS LAST, "d".a2 ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT region, total_approved_amount FROM (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", SUM("l".amount) AS "total_approved_amount", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM("l".amount) DESC) AS "ranking" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".date + "l".duration * INTERVAL '1 month' > DATE '1995-12-31' GROUP BY "d".a3) AS "totals" WHERE ranking = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id) FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'north Bohemia' AND "a".date < DATE '1996-01-01' AND "t".bank = 'AB' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11), 2) AS "average_salary", COUNT(*) AS "district_count" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "a".district_id FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id WHERE "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1990-01-01') AS "served" ON "served".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'east Bohemia' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11), 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "c".district_id FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".client_id = "c".client_id LEFT JOIN "disp" AS "account_disp" ON "account_disp".account_id = "owner_disp".account_id LEFT JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca".disp_id = "account_disp".disp_id WHERE "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' GROUP BY "c".district_id, "owner_disp".account_id HAVING COUNT("ca".card_id) = 0) AS "eligible" ON "eligible".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("account_loans".loan_count), 2) AS "average_loans_per_account" FROM (SELECT "a".account_id, COUNT("l".loan_id) AS "loan_count" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".account_id = "a".account_id AND "d".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1950-01-01' LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id GROUP BY "a".account_id) AS "account_loans" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "t".k_symbol = 'SIPO') AS "household_payments", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "t".k_symbol IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("t".k_symbol) <> '' AND "t".k_symbol <> 'SIPO') AS "other_purpose_payments" FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".amount > 4000 AND "t".account_id IN (SELECT "d".account_id FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id WHERE "c".gender = 'M' AND "c".birth_date >= DATE '1974-01-01' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1977-01-01') LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".account_id AS "account_number", "a".date AS "account_opening_date", "l".total_borrowed, COALESCE("t".counterparties, 0) AS "outside_bank_counterparties", "home".a2 AS "owner_home_district", "home".a4::BIGINT AS "district_population", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "home".a4::BIGINT DESC) AS "population_rank" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "branch" ON "branch".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN (SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS "total_borrowed" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".account_id = "a".account_id AND "d".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "home" ON "home".district_id = "c".district_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT account) AS "counterparties" FROM "trans" WHERE operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU') AND account IS NOT NULL AND account <> 0 GROUP BY account_id) AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "branch".a2 = 'Prachatice' ORDER BY "home".a4::BIGINT DESC, "a".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".gender, "s".district_count, "s".district, "s".inhabitants, "s".average_salary, "s".average_urban_inhabitant_ratio FROM (SELECT "x".gender, "x".a2 AS "district", "x".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY "x".gender) AS "district_count", ROUND(AVG("x".a11) OVER (PARTITION BY "x".gender), 2) AS "average_salary", ROUND(AVG("x".a10::NUMERIC) OVER (PARTITION BY "x".gender), 2) AS "average_urban_inhabitant_ratio", MAX("x".a4::BIGINT) OVER (PARTITION BY "x".gender) AS "maximum_inhabitants" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "c".gender, "d".district_id, "d".a2, "d".a4, "d".a10, "d".a11 FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "cd" ON "cd".disp_id = "ca".disp_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner" ON "owner".account_id = "cd".account_id AND "owner".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "owner".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "cd".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN (SELECT account_id FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id HAVING AVG(balance) > 1000) AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "ca".type = 'gold' AND "d".a4::BIGINT > 100000) AS "x") AS "s" WHERE "s".inhabitants = "s".maximum_inhabitants ORDER BY "s".gender ASC, "s".district ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "t".bank AS "recipient_bank_code", "t".account AS "recipient_counter_account_number", COUNT(*) AS "number_of_outgoing_payments", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount_paid" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "t".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "di".account_id FROM "disp" AS "di" INNER JOIN "card" AS "c" ON "c".disp_id = "di".disp_id WHERE "di".type = 'OWNER' AND "c".type = 'gold') AS "gold_accounts" ON "gold_accounts".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a4::BIGINT >= 250000 AND "t".date >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1999-01-01' AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL AND "t".account <> 0 GROUP BY "t".bank, "t".account ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN "t".amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM("t".amount), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "t".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "d".a2 ILIKE 'Pisek' AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".k_symbol IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("t".k_symbol) <> '' LIMIT 501

SELECT "x".a3 AS "region", ROUND(AVG("x".a11), 2) AS "average_district_salary", ROUND(AVG("x".a12::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_1996_unemployment_rate", MAX(CASE WHEN "x".rn = 1 THEN "x".a2 END) AS "most_populous_district" FROM (SELECT "q".a3, "q".a2, "q".a11, "q".a12, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "q".a3 ORDER BY "q".a4::BIGINT DESC, "q".a2 ASC) AS "rn" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "d".district_id, "d".a3, "d".a2, "d".a4, "d".a11, "d".a12 FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "p" ON "p".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca".disp_id = "p".disp_id INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "p".account_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "p".type = 'OWNER') AS "q") AS "x" GROUP BY "x".a3 ORDER BY "x".a3 ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a15 AS "crimes_1996", ROUND(AVG("d".a15) OVER (), 2) AS "three_district_average", ROUND((SELECT AVG(a15) FROM "district"), 2) AS "overall_average", ROUND(AVG("d".a15) OVER () - (SELECT AVG(a15) FROM "district"), 2) AS "difference" FROM (SELECT a2, a4, a15 FROM "district" WHERE a3 = 'central Bohemia' ORDER BY CAST(a4 AS BIGINT) DESC, translate(lower(a2), 'áäčďéěíľĺňóôöřšťúůüýž', 'aacdeeillnooorstuuuyz') ASC, a2 ASC LIMIT 3) AS "d" ORDER BY CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT) DESC, translate(lower("d".a2), 'áäčďéěíľĺňóôöřšťúůüýž', 'aacdeeillnooorstuuuyz') ASC, "d".a2 ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT card_type, district, inhabitants FROM (SELECT "c".type AS "card_type", "d".a2 AS "district", CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT) AS "inhabitants", MIN(CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT)) OVER (PARTITION BY "c".type) AS "min_inhabitants" FROM "card" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".disp_id = "c".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "cl" ON "cl".client_id = "dp".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "cl".district_id WHERE "c".type IN ('gold', 'classic', 'junior')) AS "markets" WHERE inhabitants = min_inhabitants ORDER BY card_type ASC, district ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", COUNT(*) AS "accounts_opened_1996", ROUND(AVG((SELECT "t".balance FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "a".account_id AND "t".date < DATE '1997-01-01' ORDER BY "t".date DESC, "t".trans_id DESC LIMIT 1)), 2) AS "average_end_of_1996_balance", ROUND(SUM(SUM((SELECT "t".balance FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "a".account_id AND "t".date < DATE '1997-01-01' ORDER BY "t".date DESC, "t".trans_id DESC LIMIT 1))) OVER () / NULLIF(SUM(COUNT((SELECT "t".balance FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "a".account_id AND "t".date < DATE '1997-01-01' ORDER BY "t".date DESC, "t".trans_id DESC LIMIT 1))) OVER (), 0), 2) AS "region_wide_average_end_of_1996_balance", FIRST_VALUE("d".a2) OVER (ORDER BY AVG((SELECT "t".balance FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "a".account_id AND "t".date < DATE '1997-01-01' ORDER BY "t".date DESC, "t".trans_id DESC LIMIT 1)) DESC NULLS LAST, "d".a2 ASC) AS "district_with_highest_average" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "a".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '1997-01-01' AND "d".a3 = (SELECT a3 FROM "district" WHERE a2 = 'Litomerice') GROUP BY "d".a2 ORDER BY "d".a2 ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", ROUND(AVG("d".a11) OVER (), 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "district" AS "d" WHERE "d".district_id IN (SELECT "top_loans".district_id FROM (SELECT "a".district_id FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".loan_id ASC LIMIT 10) AS "top_loans") ORDER BY "d".a4::BIGINT DESC, "d".district_id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "population", "w".total_withdrawn, ROUND("w".total_withdrawn / "d".a4::NUMERIC, 2) AS "withdrawals_per_inhabitant", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "w".total_withdrawn / "d".a4::NUMERIC DESC) AS "district_rank", ROUND("o".total_order_debits / "o".account_count, 2) AS "average_standing_order_debit_per_account" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN (SELECT "a".district_id, SUM("t".amount) AS "total_withdrawn" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ' GROUP BY "a".district_id) AS "w" ON "w".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN (SELECT "a".district_id, COUNT(*) AS "account_count", SUM(COALESCE("s".total_debits, 0)) AS "total_order_debits" FROM "account" AS "a" LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, SUM(amount::NUMERIC) AS "total_debits" FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id) AS "s" ON "s".account_id = "a".account_id GROUP BY "a".district_id) AS "o" ON "o".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a4::BIGINT >= 100000 ORDER BY district_rank ASC, "d".a2 ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "opened_date", "a".frequency, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", CASE WHEN "d".district_id = "c".district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "home_district", "d".a11 AS "average_salary", COALESCE("l".status, 'none') AS "loan_repayment_status", COALESCE("l".amount, 0) AS "loan_amount", COALESCE("t".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE("t".total_income, 0) AS "total_income", COALESCE("t".total_expense, 0) AS "total_expense", COALESCE("t".total_income, 0) - COALESCE("t".total_expense, 0) AS "net_balance", COALESCE("rc".client_count, 0) AS "region_client_count", "rd".most_populous_district, "rd".most_populous_inhabitants, "d".population_rank FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "di" ON "di".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "di".account_id INNER JOIN (SELECT district_id, a2, a3, a11, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY CAST(a4 AS BIGINT) DESC) AS "population_rank" FROM "district") AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_income", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_expense" FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id) AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "district".a3, COUNT(*) AS "client_count" FROM "client" INNER JOIN "district" ON "client".district_id = "district".district_id GROUP BY "district".a3) AS "rc" ON "rc".a3 = "d".a3 INNER JOIN (SELECT a3, a2 AS "most_populous_district", CAST(a4 AS BIGINT) AS "most_populous_inhabitants", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY CAST(a4 AS BIGINT) DESC, district_id ASC) AS "rn" FROM "district") AS "rd" ON "rd".a3 = "d".a3 AND "rd".rn = 1 WHERE "c".client_id = 3541 ORDER BY COALESCE("t".transaction_count, 0) DESC, "a".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT year, SUM(account_count) AS "accounts_opened", SUM(amount_lent) AS "total_amount_lent", ROUND(AVG(amount_lent / account_count), 2) AS "average_district_amount_lent_per_account" FROM (SELECT TO_CHAR("a".date, 'YYYY') AS "year", "a".district_id, COUNT(*) AS "account_count", SUM(COALESCE("l".amount_lent, 0)) AS "amount_lent" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS "amount_lent" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' AND "a".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY TO_CHAR("a".date, 'YYYY'), "a".district_id) AS "district_year" GROUP BY year ORDER BY year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district", "l".amount AS "approved_amount", "l".date AS "approval_date", (SELECT "t".balance FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "l".account_id AND "t".date <= "l".date ORDER BY "t".date DESC, "t".trans_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS "account_balance" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".date ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT "c".client_id, "c".gender, "c".birth_date, "ca".type AS "card_type", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ca".issued) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "c".birth_date) AS "age_at_card_issue", COALESCE("l".number_of_loans, 0) AS "number_of_loans", COALESCE("l".total_amount_borrowed, 0) AS "total_amount_borrowed", CASE WHEN COALESCE("l".number_of_loans, 0) = 0 THEN 'Non-borrower' WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ca".issued) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "c".birth_date) < 30 THEN 'Young borrower' ELSE 'Mature borrower' END AS "borrower_classification", "di".a2 AS "district_name", "di".a11 AS "district_average_salary", RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "c".gender ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ca".issued) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "c".birth_date) DESC) AS "age_rank_within_gender" FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".disp_id = "ca".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "di" ON "di".district_id = "c".district_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_loans", SUM(amount) AS "total_amount_borrowed" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "d".account_id WHERE "ca".issued >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "ca".issued < DATE '1995-01-01' ORDER BY "c".client_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "branch_name", COUNT("t".trans_id) AS "transaction_count" FROM "district" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id LEFT JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id AND "t".date < DATE '1998-10-15' AND ("t".k_symbol IS NULL OR TRIM("t".k_symbol) = '') WHERE "d".a3 = 'north Moravia' GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2 ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, branch_name ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "t".bank AS "bank_code", "t".account AS "account_number", COUNT(*) AS "outgoing_payments", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount_paid" FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id IN (SELECT "l".account_id FROM "loan" AS "l" WHERE "l".amount = 98832 AND "l".date = DATE '1996-01-03') AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".date < DATE '1996-01-03' AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL AND "t".account <> 0 GROUP BY "t".bank, "t".account ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id) AS "account_count" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "a".district_id = 1 AND "a".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".status IN ('C', 'D') LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'UROK' THEN "t".amount WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'SANKC. UROK' THEN -"t".amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "net_interest_czk" FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id IN (SELECT "d".account_id FROM "disp" AS "d" WHERE "d".client_id = 2823) AND "t".date >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1999-01-01' AND "t".k_symbol IN ('UROK', 'SANKC. UROK') LIMIT 501

SELECT "f".client_id, ROUND("f".amount::NUMERIC, 2) AS "loan_amount", "f".duration AS "duration_months", ROUND("f".payments::NUMERIC * "f".duration, 2) AS "total_payments", ROUND("f".payments::NUMERIC * "f".duration - "f".amount, 2) AS "interest_paid", "f".status AS "loan_status", "d".a2 AS "district", "d".a3 AS "region", COALESCE("t".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", ROUND(COALESCE("t".total_deposits, 0)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "total_deposits", CASE WHEN COALESCE("t".total_deposits, 0) > 2 * "f".amount THEN 'High Income' WHEN COALESCE("t".total_deposits, 0) > "f".amount THEN 'Medium Income' ELSE 'Low Income' END AS "income_category", "r".loan_count AS "regional_loan_count", "s".average_salary AS "regional_average_salary", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "f".birth_date))::INTEGER AS "age" FROM (SELECT "l".loan_id, "l".account_id, "l".amount, "l".duration, "l".payments, "l".status, "c".client_id, "c".birth_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "l".amount DESC) AS "loan_rank" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "l".account_id AND "dp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F') AS "f" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "f".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_deposits" FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id) AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "f".account_id INNER JOIN (SELECT "d2".a3 AS "region", COUNT(*) AS "loan_count" FROM "loan" AS "l2" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a2" ON "a2".account_id = "l2".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d2" ON "d2".district_id = "a2".district_id GROUP BY "d2".a3) AS "r" ON "r".region = "d".a3 INNER JOIN (SELECT a3 AS "region", ROUND(AVG(a11), 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "district" GROUP BY a3) AS "s" ON "s".region = "d".a3 WHERE "f".loan_rank <= 3 ORDER BY "f".amount DESC, "f".loan_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", COUNT(*) AS "district_count", SUM("d".a4::BIGINT) AS "combined_population", SUM("q".account_count) AS "account_count" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN (SELECT "a".district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id) AS "account_count" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "a".date < DATE '1997-01-01' AND "l".duration > 24 GROUP BY "a".district_id) AS "q" ON "q".district_id = "d".district_id GROUP BY "d".a3 ORDER BY combined_population DESC, "d".a3 ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(SUM("q".account_count), 0) AS "total_accounts", COUNT(*) AS "district_count", ROUND(AVG("q".a11), 2) AS "average_salary" FROM (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a11, COUNT(*) AS "account_count" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a4::BIGINT >= 100000 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' AND "a".date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a11) AS "q" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".account_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", COALESCE("t".total_received, 0) AS "total_received", COALESCE("t".total_withdrawn, 0) AS "total_withdrawn", COALESCE("l".loan_count, 0) AS "loan_count", COALESCE("t".external_counterparties, 0) AS "external_counterparties", DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE("t".external_counterparties, 0) DESC) AS "rank" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "di".account_id FROM "disp" AS "di" INNER JOIN "card" AS "c" ON "c".disp_id = "di".disp_id WHERE "c".type = 'gold') AS "g" ON "g".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE type = 'PRIJEM') AS "total_received", SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE type = 'VYDAJ') AS "total_withdrawn", COUNT(DISTINCT (bank, account)) FILTER (WHERE operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU') AND bank IS NOT NULL AND account IS NOT NULL AND account <> 0) AS "external_counterparties" FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id) AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "loan_count" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id ORDER BY rank ASC, "a".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".account_id, "p".opened_date, "p".gender, "p".age, "p".card_count, "p".loan_count, "p".loan_standing, "p".transaction_count, "p".money_in, "p".money_out, "p".peak_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "p".peak_balance DESC) AS "balance_rank" FROM (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "opened_date", "c".gender, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '1996-12-31', "c".birth_date)) AS "age", COALESCE("cards".card_count, 0) AS "card_count", COALESCE("loans".loan_count, 0) AS "loan_count", CASE WHEN "loans".loan_count IS NULL THEN 'no loan' WHEN "loans".has_default THEN 'defaulted' WHEN "loans".has_repaying THEN 'repaying' ELSE 'paid off' END AS "loan_standing", COALESCE("t".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE("t".money_in, 0) AS "money_in", COALESCE("t".money_out, 0) AS "money_out", COALESCE("t".peak_balance, 0) AS "peak_balance" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".account_id = "a".account_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "owner_disp".client_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "di".account_id, COUNT(*) AS "card_count" FROM "disp" AS "di" INNER JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca".disp_id = "di".disp_id WHERE "ca".issued < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY "di".account_id) AS "cards" ON "cards".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "loan_count", BOOL_OR(status = 'B') AS "has_default", BOOL_OR(status IN ('C', 'D')) AS "has_repaying" FROM "loan" WHERE date < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY account_id) AS "loans" ON "loans".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "money_in", SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('VYDAJ', 'VYBER') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "money_out", MAX(balance) AS "peak_balance" FROM "trans" WHERE date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND date < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY account_id) AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a2 = 'Tabor' AND "a".date < DATE '1997-01-01') AS "p" ORDER BY balance_rank ASC, "p".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", COUNT(DISTINCT "o".client_id) AS "client_count", COUNT(DISTINCT ("t".bank, "t".account)) FILTER (WHERE "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL AND "t".account <> 0) AS "external_account_count", COALESCE(SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL AND "t".account <> 0), 0) AS "total_amount_paid" FROM "district" AS "d" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "a".district_id, "a".account_id, "dp".client_id FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "a".account_id AND "dp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "card" AS "c" ON "c".disp_id = "dp".disp_id AND "c".type = 'classic') AS "o" ON "o".district_id = "d".district_id LEFT JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "o".account_id AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2 ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC, "d".a2 ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11), 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "a".district_id FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "p" ON "p".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "p".client_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1930-01-01') AS "matching_districts" ON "matching_districts".district_id = "d".district_id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11), 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT district_id FROM "client" WHERE gender = 'F' AND birth_date < DATE '1950-01-01') AS "c" ON "c".district_id = "d".district_id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11), 2) AS "average_district_salary" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "a".district_id FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "l".amount < 100000 AND "l".status = 'C') AS "eligible" ON "eligible".district_id = "d".district_id LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' THEN 'young' ELSE 'old' END AS "cohort", ROUND(AVG("d".a11)) AS "average_salary" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "p" ON "p".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "p".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' OR "c".birth_date < DATE '1920-01-01' GROUP BY CASE WHEN "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' THEN 'young' ELSE 'old' END ORDER BY CASE WHEN CASE WHEN "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' THEN 'young' ELSE 'old' END = 'young' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND((MAX(CASE WHEN "r".raceid = 853 THEN "r".fastestlapspeed::NUMERIC END) - MAX(CASE WHEN "r".raceid = 854 THEN "r".fastestlapspeed::NUMERIC END)) * 100 / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN "r".raceid = 854 THEN "r".fastestlapspeed::NUMERIC END), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "r".driverid WHERE "d".forename = 'Paul' AND "d".surname = 'di Resta' AND "r".raceid IN (853, 854) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "res".position = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage_not_victories" FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "res".raceid WHERE "d".forename = 'Lewis' AND "d".surname = 'Hamilton' AND "r".year >= 2010 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".nationality, (SELECT MAX("ds".points) FROM "driverstandings" AS "ds" WHERE "ds".driverid = "d".driverid) AS "highest_recorded_driver_standings_points" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".position = 1 GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".nationality ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * ("last_finisher".milliseconds - "winner".milliseconds) / "last_finisher".milliseconds, 2) AS "percentage_shorter" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "winner" ON "winner".raceid = "r".raceid AND "winner".position = 1 INNER JOIN "results" AS "last_finisher" ON "last_finisher".raceid = "r".raceid AND "last_finisher".laps = "winner".laps AND "last_finisher".position IS NOT NULL WHERE "r".year = 1988 AND "r".name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND "last_finisher".position = (SELECT MAX("res".position) FROM "results" AS "res" WHERE "res".raceid = "r".raceid AND "res".laps = "winner".laps AND "res".position IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "entry".laps = "winner".laps) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "results" AS "entry" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "entry".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "entry".raceid INNER JOIN "results" AS "winner" ON "winner".raceid = "entry".raceid AND "winner".position = 1 WHERE "d".nationality = 'Japanese' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009 LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, ROUND(AVG("res".milliseconds::NUMERIC) / 1000, 2) AS "mean_winner_elapsed_time_seconds" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year < 1975 AND "res".position = 1 AND "res".milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "r".year ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "d".dob < DATE '1985-01-01' AND "res".laps > 50) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "percentage" FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "res".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "r".year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005 LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("cr".points) AS "score", "c".name, "c".nationality FROM "constructorresults" AS "cr" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "cr".raceid INNER JOIN "constructors" AS "c" ON "c".constructorid = "cr".constructorid WHERE "r".name = 'Monaco Grand Prix' AND "r".year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010 GROUP BY "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".nationality ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "c".name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit' AND "r".year = 2008 AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q".q3) <> '' ORDER BY SPLIT_PART("q".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + SPLIT_PART("q".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "full_name" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "laptimes" AS "l" ON "l".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "l".milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname ORDER BY MIN("l".milliseconds) ASC, "d".forename ASC, "d".surname ASC LIMIT 20

SELECT "c".name, (MIN("l".milliseconds) / 60000)::TEXT || ':' || TO_CHAR((MIN("l".milliseconds) % 60000) / 1000, 'FM00') || '.' || TO_CHAR(MIN("l".milliseconds) % 1000, 'FM000') AS "fastest_lap_time" FROM "circuits" AS "c" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".circuitid = "c".circuitid INNER JOIN "laptimes" AS "l" ON "l".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "c".country = 'Italy' AND "l".milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "c".circuitid, "c".name LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(pit_stop_count), 2) AS "average_pit_stops_per_race" FROM (SELECT "r".raceid, COUNT("p".raceid) AS "pit_stop_count" FROM "races" AS "r" LEFT JOIN "pitstops" AS "p" ON "p".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "races" AS "r2000" WHERE "r2000".year = 2000 AND "r2000".name = "r".name) GROUP BY "r".raceid) AS "race_pit_stops" LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".url, "d".dob, COUNT(NULLIF(TRIM("q".q3), '')) AS "q3_times" FROM "drivers" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "qualifying" AS "q" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".nationality = 'German' AND "d".dob >= DATE '1971-01-01' AND "d".dob < DATE '1986-01-01' GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".url, "d".dob ORDER BY q3_times DESC, "d".dob ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref, "d".nationality, "d".dob, "q".q1 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 1995 AND "r".name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q".q1) <> '' AND "q".q1 = (SELECT "q2".q1 FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "q2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 1995 AND "r2".name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND "q2".q1 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q2".q1) <> '' ORDER BY (SPLIT_PART("q2".q1, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + SPLIT_PART("q2".q1, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) DESC LIMIT 1) LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 1995 AND "r".name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND NULLIF(TRIM("q".q1), '') IS NOT NULL AND "q".q1 = (SELECT MAX("q2".q1) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "r".raceid AND NULLIF(TRIM("q2".q1), '') IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "q".q1 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 1995 AND "r".name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND NULLIF(TRIM("q".q1), '') IS NOT NULL AND "q".q1::INTERVAL = (SELECT MIN("q2".q1::INTERVAL) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "q2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 1995 AND "r2".name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND NULLIF(TRIM("q2".q1), '') IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "opponent".driverid) AS "drivers_outqualified" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "qualifying" AS "lucas" ON "lucas".driverid = "d".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "lucas".raceid INNER JOIN "qualifying" AS "opponent" ON "opponent".raceid = "lucas".raceid AND "opponent".position > "lucas".position WHERE "d".forename = 'Lucas' AND "d".surname = 'di Grassi' AND "r".year = 2010 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND NULLIF(TRIM("q".q2), '') IS NOT NULL AND "q".q2 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q2) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "r".raceid AND NULLIF(TRIM("q2".q2), '') IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, COUNT(*) AS "runners_up" FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "res".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "res".position = 2 GROUP BY "d".forename HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY runners_up DESC, "d".forename ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, TO_CHAR("r".date + CAST("r".time AS TIME) + "res".milliseconds * INTERVAL '1 millisecond' + INTERVAL '4 hours', 'HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS "local_finish_time", "d".url FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Azerbaijan Grand Prix' AND "res".position = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref, "d".nationality, "d".dob FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q".q2) <> '' AND ("q".q3 IS NULL OR TRIM("q".q3) = '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND NULLIF(TRIM("q".q2), '') IS NOT NULL AND "q".q2 = (SELECT "q2".q2 FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "r".raceid AND NULLIF(TRIM("q2".q2), '') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "q2".q2 ASC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "q".driverid) AS "driver_count" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q".q2) <> '' AND split_part("q".q2, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q".q2, ':', 2)::NUMERIC < 100 LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".name, "c".location, "c".country, "r".year, "p".milliseconds AS "pit_stop_length_milliseconds" FROM "pitstops" AS "p" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "p".raceid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "p".milliseconds = (SELECT MAX(milliseconds) FROM "pitstops") LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("q3_counts".q3_count), 2) AS "average_q3_lap_times" FROM (SELECT "d".driverid, COUNT("q".q3) FILTER (WHERE TRIM("q".q3) <> '') AS "q3_count" FROM "drivers" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "qualifying" AS "q" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".dob >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "d".dob < DATE '1992-01-01' GROUP BY "d".driverid) AS "q3_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "qualifying_1_times" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN (SELECT forename FROM "drivers" GROUP BY forename HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS "shared" ON "shared".forename = "d".forename WHERE "d".code IS NULL AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q1 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' AND (split_part("q".q1, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q".q1, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) > 120 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref, COALESCE(SUM("r".points), 0) AS "total_points" FROM "drivers" AS "d" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "r".driverid, "r".points FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT driverid, raceid FROM "laptimes") AS "l" ON "l".driverid = "r".driverid AND "l".raceid = "r".raceid) AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".forename = 'Robert' GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".driverref LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".date, "d".forename, "d".surname, ("f".fastest_ms / 60000)::TEXT || ':' || TO_CHAR(("f".fastest_ms % 60000) * INTERVAL '1 millisecond', 'SS.MS') AS "fastest_lap_time" FROM "races" AS "r" LEFT JOIN (SELECT raceid, driverid, MIN(milliseconds) AS "fastest_ms" FROM "laptimes" WHERE milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY raceid, driverid HAVING MIN(milliseconds) > 90000) AS "f" ON "f".raceid = "r".raceid LEFT JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "f".driverid WHERE "r".name = 'French Grand Prix' AND "r".year >= 1990 ORDER BY "r".date ASC, "d".surname ASC, "d".forename ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".forename, "d".surname, "q".q3 AS "fastest_q3_lap_time" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "d".nationality = 'Italian' AND NULLIF(TRIM("q".q3), '') IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3::INTERVAL = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3::INTERVAL) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d2" ON "d2".driverid = "q2".driverid WHERE "d2".nationality = 'Italian' AND NULLIF(TRIM("q2".q3), '') IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "driver_name", "r".name AS "race_name", "r".year AS "race_year", "q".q3 AS "q3_time" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "d".nationality = 'British' AND "d".dob >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "q".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$' AND split_part("q".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC = (SELECT MIN(split_part("q2".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q2".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d2" ON "d2".driverid = "q2".driverid WHERE "d2".nationality = 'British' AND "d2".dob >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "q2".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$') LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "d".driverid) AS "driver_count" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".dob >= DATE '1976-01-01' AND "r".rank = 2 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND "q".q3::INTERVAL = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3::INTERVAL) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "r".raceid AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q2".q3) <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "ranked".name, "ranked".career_points, "ranked".url FROM (SELECT "totals".name, "totals".career_points, "totals".url, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "totals".career_points DESC) AS "ranking" FROM (SELECT "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".url, COALESCE(SUM("final_standings".points), 0) AS "career_points" FROM "constructors" AS "c" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "cs".constructorid, "cs".points, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "cs".constructorid, "r".year ORDER BY "r".round DESC, "r".date DESC, "r".raceid DESC) AS "season_order" FROM "constructorstandings" AS "cs" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "cs".raceid) AS "final_standings" ON "final_standings".constructorid = "c".constructorid AND "final_standings".season_order = 1 WHERE "c".nationality = 'Italian' GROUP BY "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".url) AS "totals") AS "ranked" WHERE "ranked".ranking <= 3 ORDER BY "ranked".ranking ASC, "ranked".name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, COUNT(DISTINCT "d".driverid) AS "driver_count" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".forename IN ('Peter', 'John') AND "r".position = 1 GROUP BY "d".forename ORDER BY CASE WHEN "d".forename = 'Peter' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE NULLIF(TRIM("q".q3), '') IS NOT NULL AND CAST("q".q3 AS INTERVAL) = (SELECT MIN(CAST("q2".q3 AS INTERVAL)) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE NULLIF(TRIM("q2".q3), '') IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".nationality, COUNT(DISTINCT "r".constructorid) AS "constructor_count" FROM "constructors" AS "c" LEFT JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".constructorid = "c".constructorid AND "r".rank = 1 GROUP BY "c".nationality ORDER BY "c".nationality ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, COUNT("p".raceid) AS "total_pit_stops" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "ds".raceid FROM "driverstandings" AS "ds" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "ds".driverid WHERE "d".nationality = 'Australian' AND "ds".position BETWEEN 1 AND 19) AS "qualifying_races" ON "qualifying_races".raceid = "r".raceid LEFT JOIN "pitstops" AS "p" ON "p".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013 GROUP BY "r".year ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "q".driverid) AS "number_of_drivers" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".date >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND "r".date < DATE '1996-01-01' AND NULLIF(TRIM("q".q1), '') IS NOT NULL AND "q".q1::INTERVAL > INTERVAL '2 minutes' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "driver_full_name", "p".duration AS "pit_stop_time", "r".name AS "race_name", "c".name AS "circuit_name", "c".location AS "circuit_location" FROM "pitstops" AS "p" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "p".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "p".raceid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".date >= '2016-09-01' AND "r".date < '2016-10-01' AND "p".milliseconds = (SELECT MIN("p2".milliseconds) FROM "pitstops" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "p2".raceid WHERE "r2".date >= '2016-09-01' AND "r2".date < '2016-10-01') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "full_name", "d".nationality, "r".name AS "first_win_race", "r".date AS "first_win_date", (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "rs".raceid) FROM "results" AS "rs" INNER JOIN "races" AS "rr" ON "rr".raceid = "rs".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "s".statusid = "rs".statusid WHERE "rs".driverid = "d".driverid AND "rr".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017 AND "s".status NOT IN ('Did not start', 'Did not qualify', 'Did not prequalify', 'Withdrawn', 'Excluded', '107% Rule')) AS "races_started" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "w" ON "w".driverid = "d".driverid AND "w".position = 1 INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "w".raceid WHERE "r".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017 ORDER BY "d".dob ASC, "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname ASC, "r".date ASC, "r".name ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "r".raceid) AS "runnings" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "s".statusid = "res".statusid WHERE "r".name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND "s".status = 'Accident' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "c".name AS "constructor_name" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "constructors" AS "c" ON "c".constructorid = "q".constructorid INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "q".raceid AND "res".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q".q2) <> '' ORDER BY CAST(SPLIT_PART("q".q2, ':', 1) AS NUMERIC) * 60 + CAST(SPLIT_PART("q".q2, ':', 2) AS NUMERIC) ASC, CASE WHEN "res".grid > 0 THEN "res".grid ELSE NULL END ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

SELECT "d".surname, "r".name FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "q".q2 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]+[.][0-9]+$' AND (SPLIT_PART("q".q2, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + SPLIT_PART("q".q2, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) = (SELECT MIN(SPLIT_PART("q2".q2, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + SPLIT_PART("q2".q2, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "q2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 2017 AND "q2".q2 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]+[.][0-9]+$') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND NULLIF(TRIM("q".q3), '') IS NOT NULL AND (SPLIT_PART("q".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + SPLIT_PART("q".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) = (SELECT MIN(SPLIT_PART("q2".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + SPLIT_PART("q2".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "q2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 2017 AND "r2".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND NULLIF(TRIM("q2".q3), '') IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".code, "q".q3 AS "fastest_q3_time" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT "q2".q3 FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "r".raceid AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q2".q3) <> '' ORDER BY SPLIT_PART("q2".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + SPLIT_PART("q2".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC ASC LIMIT 1) LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "r".raceid AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q2".q3) <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, "res".time AS "runner_up_time_gap" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid AND "res".position = 2 WHERE "r".raceid = (SELECT raceid FROM "races" WHERE name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009 AND time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time ASC, year DESC LIMIT 1) LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".code FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q".q3) <> '' ORDER BY "d".code ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, "d".forename, "d".surname, "res".time AS "finish_time" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "r".name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2017 AND "r".time IS NOT NULL AND CAST("r".time AS TIME) <= CAST('21:00:00' AS TIME) AND "res".position = 1 ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number, "d".surname FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND (SPLIT_PART("q".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + SPLIT_PART("q".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) < 98 LIMIT 501

SELECT "early".circuitref AS "earliest_circuit_reference", "late".circuitref AS "latest_circuit_reference", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("late".start_time - "early".start_time)) AS "gap_seconds" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "c".circuitref, "r".time::TIME AS "start_time" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".time IS NOT NULL AND "r".time::TIME = (SELECT MIN("r2".time::TIME) FROM "races" AS "r2" WHERE "r2".time IS NOT NULL)) AS "early" CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "c".circuitref, "r".time::TIME AS "start_time" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".time IS NOT NULL AND "r".time::TIME = (SELECT MAX("r2".time::TIME) FROM "races" AS "r2" WHERE "r2".time IS NOT NULL)) AS "late" LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".dob >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND "d".dob < DATE '1990-01-01' AND "r".fastestlapspeed IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("r".fastestlapspeed) <> '' GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".dob ORDER BY MAX(CAST("r".fastestlapspeed AS NUMERIC)) DESC, "d".dob ASC, "d".surname ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "d".driverref FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND ("q".q2 IS NULL OR TRIM("q".q2) = '') ORDER BY CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM("q".q1), '') IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE SPLIT_PART("q".q1, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + SPLIT_PART("q".q1, ':', 2)::NUMERIC END DESC NULLS FIRST, "d".driverid ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "r".driverid) FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "s".statusid = "r".statusid WHERE "ra".year = 1962 AND "ra".name = 'British Grand Prix' AND "s".status = 'Withdrew' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "s".status = 'Finished' OR "s".status ~ '^[+][0-9]+ Laps?$' THEN "res".driverid END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "res".driverid), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "s".statusid = "res".statusid WHERE "r".year = 1957 AND "r".name = 'British Grand Prix' AND "res".grid > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("event_expenses".total_expense)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "mean_total_expense_per_event" FROM (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM("e".cost) AS "total_expense" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "m".first_name = 'Elijah' AND "m".last_name = 'Allen' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "e".expense_date::DATE) IN (9, 10) GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "event_expenses" LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "e".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-01-01' THEN "b".spent ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "e".event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2021-01-01' THEN "b".spent ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "difference" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2021-01-01' LIMIT 501
SELECT notes FROM "income" WHERE source = 'Fundraising' AND date_received = '2019-09-14' LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "e".event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN "b".amount END)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN "e".event_name = 'October Meeting' THEN "b".amount END), 0) AS "ratio" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "b".category = 'Advertisement' AND "e".event_name IN ('Yearly Kickoff', 'October Meeting') LIMIT 501

SELECT event_name, spending_to_budget_ratio FROM (SELECT "e".event_name, SUM("b".spent)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM("b".amount), 0) AS "spending_to_budget_ratio", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM("b".spent)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM("b".amount), 0) DESC NULLS LAST) AS "ratio_rank" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name HAVING SUM("b".amount) <> 0 AND SUM("b".spent) IS NOT NULL) AS "ranked" WHERE ratio_rank = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name, "m".last_name FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_event) > 7 LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name, "m".last_name, "m".phone FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT link_to_member FROM "expense" WHERE cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM "expense")) AS "e" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id LIMIT 501

SELECT "soccer".attendance AS "womens_soccer_attendance", "fall".rounded_average AS "average_fall_attendance", CASE WHEN "soccer".attendance > "fall".rounded_average THEN 'more' WHEN "soccer".attendance < "fall".rounded_average THEN 'fewer' ELSE 'equal' END AS "verdict" FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendance" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_name = 'Women''s Soccer') AS "soccer" CROSS JOIN (SELECT ROUND(AVG("event_counts".attendance), 1) AS "rounded_average" FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendance" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2019-12-01' GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "event_counts") AS "fall" LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".department, COUNT(DISTINCT "d".major_id) AS "majors_offered", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "m".member_id IS NOT NULL THEN "d".major_id END) AS "majors_held", ROUND(COUNT("m".member_id)::NUMERIC / COUNT(DISTINCT "d".major_id), 2) AS "average_members_per_major" FROM "major" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".link_to_major = "d".major_id WHERE "d".department IN (SELECT "c".department FROM "major" AS "c" WHERE "c".college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences') GROUP BY "d".department ORDER BY "d".department ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".type AS "event_type", COALESCE(SUM("a".member_count), 0) AS "members_attended", COALESCE(SUM("b".budgeted_amount), 0) AS "total_budgeted" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(link_to_member) AS "member_count" FROM "attendance" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, SUM(amount) AS "budgeted_amount" FROM "budget" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-01-01' GROUP BY "e".type ORDER BY "e".type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".department, COALESCE(SUM("i".amount), 0) AS "total_dues" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT department FROM "major" WHERE college IN (SELECT college FROM "major" WHERE department = 'Electrical and Computer Engineering Department')) AS "d" LEFT JOIN "major" AS "m" ON "m".department = "d".department AND "m".college IN (SELECT college FROM "major" WHERE department = 'Electrical and Computer Engineering Department') LEFT JOIN "member" AS "mem" ON "mem".link_to_major = "m".major_id AND "mem".position = 'Member' AND "mem".member_id IN (SELECT link_to_member FROM "attendance") LEFT JOIN "income" AS "i" ON "i".link_to_member = "mem".member_id AND "i".source = 'Dues' GROUP BY "d".department ORDER BY "d".department ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name, "m".last_name, ROUND(SUM("b".amount::NUMERIC - "b".spent::NUMERIC), 2) AS "total_amount_left" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "e" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".budget_id = "e".link_to_budget WHERE "e".cost > 50 GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name ORDER BY total_amount_left DESC, "m".last_name ASC, "m".first_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("i".amount) AS "total_dues" FROM "income" AS "i" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "a".link_to_member FROM "attendance" AS "a" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e".event_id = "a".link_to_event WHERE "e".type = 'Game' AND "e".event_name ILIKE '%football%') AS "attendees" ON "attendees".link_to_member = "i".link_to_member WHERE "i".source = 'Dues' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "m".major_name) AS "major_count" FROM "major" AS "m" WHERE "m".college IN (SELECT "tyler_major".college FROM "member" AS "tyler" INNER JOIN "major" AS "tyler_major" ON "tyler".link_to_major = "tyler_major".major_id WHERE "tyler".first_name = 'Tyler' AND "tyler".last_name = 'Hewitt') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "major" AS "same_major" INNER JOIN "member" AS "enrolled" ON "enrolled".link_to_major = "same_major".major_id WHERE "same_major".college = "m".college AND "same_major".major_name = "m".major_name) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("event_attendance".member_count), 2) AS "average_members" FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "member_count" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id AND "b".category = 'Advertisement' LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "event_attendance" LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".location, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "number_of_members_attended" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".type = 'Budget' AND "e".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name, "e".location LIMIT 501

SELECT "ma".major_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "m".member_id) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".member_id = "a".link_to_member INNER JOIN "major" AS "ma" ON "ma".major_id = "m".link_to_major WHERE "e".event_name = 'Football game' GROUP BY "ma".major_id, "ma".major_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "m".member_id) = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "m2".member_id) FROM "event" AS "e2" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a2" ON "a2".link_to_event = "e2".event_id INNER JOIN "member" AS "m2" ON "m2".member_id = "a2".link_to_member INNER JOIN "major" AS "ma2" ON "ma2".major_id = "m2".link_to_major WHERE "e2".event_name = 'Football game' GROUP BY "ma2".major_id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT "m2".member_id) DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY "ma".major_name ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "member" WHERE "member".link_to_major = "major".major_id)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "major" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_count) FILTER (WHERE position IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer')), 2) AS "average_events_per_officer", ROUND(AVG(event_count) FILTER (WHERE position NOT IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer') OR position IS NULL), 2) AS "average_events_per_other_student" FROM (SELECT "m".member_id, "m".position, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_event) AS "event_count" FROM "member" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".position) AS "member_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT item) AS "count" FROM (SELECT LOWER(TRIM(SPLIT_PART("e".expense_description, ',', 1))) AS "item" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".link_to_event IN (SELECT link_to_event FROM "budget" WHERE amount - spent < 0) UNION ALL SELECT LOWER(TRIM(SPLIT_PART("e".expense_description, ',', 2))) AS "item" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".link_to_event IN (SELECT link_to_event FROM "budget" WHERE amount - spent < 0) UNION ALL SELECT LOWER(TRIM(SPLIT_PART("e".expense_description, ',', 3))) AS "item" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".link_to_event IN (SELECT link_to_event FROM "budget" WHERE amount - spent < 0)) AS "items" WHERE item <> '' LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, ROUND(COALESCE("w".water_cost, 0)::NUMERIC / "a".attendee_count, 2) AS "water_spent_per_attendee" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "attendance" WHERE link_to_member IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM("x".cost) AS "water_cost" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description ILIKE '%water%' GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "w" ON "w".link_to_event = "e".event_id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "d".department IS NOT NULL) AS "members_in_college", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "d".department IS NULL) AS "members_not_in_college" FROM "member" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "major" AS "a" ON "a".major_id = "m".link_to_major LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT department FROM "major" WHERE college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences') AS "d" ON "d".department = "a".department LIMIT 501

SELECT event_name FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, "e".event_name, MAX("b".amount) AS "largest_line", DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY MAX("b".amount) DESC NULLS LAST) AS "budget_rank" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "cb" ON "cb".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "cb".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description ILIKE '%chips%' AND "x".cost > 0 GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name) AS "ranked_events" WHERE budget_rank = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".expense_date, SUM("e".cost::NUMERIC) AS "total_cost" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "m".position = 'Vice President' AND "e".expense_date = (SELECT MAX("e2".expense_date) FROM "expense" AS "e2" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m2" ON "e2".link_to_member = "m2".member_id WHERE "m2".position = 'Vice President') GROUP BY "e".expense_date LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".type AS "event_category", COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "number_of_members" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".location = 'MU 215' GROUP BY "e".type LIMIT 501

SELECT "ma".college, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_majors" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "major" AS "ma" ON "m".link_to_major = "ma".major_id GROUP BY "ma".college HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "member" AS "m2" INNER JOIN "major" AS "ma2" ON "m2".link_to_major = "ma2".major_id GROUP BY "ma2".college ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY "ma".college ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".location, COUNT(DISTINCT "x".expense_description) AS "number_of_different_things_bought" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "qualifying_budget" ON "qualifying_budget".link_to_event = "e".event_id AND "qualifying_budget".amount > 40 INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id GROUP BY "e".location LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("b".amount) AS "total_amount_budgeted" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e".event_id = "b".link_to_event INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "pizza_budget".link_to_event FROM "budget" AS "pizza_budget" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "pizza_budget".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description = 'Pizza') AS "pizza_events" ON "pizza_events".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2019-10-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("b".total_spent, 0))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_spent_per_event" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, SUM(spent) AS "total_spent" FROM "budget" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM("b".amount) AS "total_budget", SUM("b".spent) AS "total_spending", SUM(COALESCE("p".purchase_count, 0)) AS "purchase_count" FROM "budget" AS "b" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "x".link_to_budget, SUM(1 + LENGTH("x".expense_description) - LENGTH(REPLACE("x".expense_description, ',', ''))) AS "purchase_count" FROM "expense" AS "x" GROUP BY "x".link_to_budget) AS "p" ON "p".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "totals" ON "totals".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".status = 'Closed' AND COALESCE("totals".total_spending, 0) <= COALESCE("totals".total_budget, 0) ORDER BY COALESCE("totals".purchase_count, 0) DESC, "e".event_id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT type, number_of_members FROM (SELECT "e".type, COUNT("a".link_to_member) AS "number_of_members", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT("a".link_to_member) DESC) AS "ranking" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-06-01' GROUP BY "e".type) AS "ranked" WHERE ranking = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".expense_description AS "item_name", COUNT(*) AS "record_count" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".category = 'Food' GROUP BY "e".expense_description ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "e".expense_description ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT item_name, category, SUM(cost::NUMERIC) AS "total_cost" FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(SPLIT_PART("x".expense_description, ',', 1))) = 'bakery - donuts' THEN 'Donuts' ELSE INITCAP(TRIM(SPLIT_PART("x".expense_description, ',', 1))) END AS "item_name", "b".category, "x".cost FROM "expense" AS "x" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_name = 'October Meeting' AND "x".approved = 'true' UNION ALL SELECT INITCAP(TRIM(SPLIT_PART("x".expense_description, ',', 2))) AS "item_name", "b".category, "x".cost FROM "expense" AS "x" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_name = 'October Meeting' AND "x".approved = 'true' AND SPLIT_PART("x".expense_description, ',', 2) <> '' UNION ALL SELECT INITCAP(TRIM(SPLIT_PART("x".expense_description, ',', 3))) AS "item_name", "b".category, "x".cost FROM "expense" AS "x" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_name = 'October Meeting' AND "x".approved = 'true' AND SPLIT_PART("x".expense_description, ',', 3) <> '') AS "items" GROUP BY item_name, category ORDER BY category ASC, item_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".event_date, COALESCE("b".total_budgeted, 0) AS "total_amount_budgeted", COALESCE("a_count".member_count, 0) AS "number_of_members_attended" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, SUM(amount) AS "total_budgeted" FROM "budget" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) AS "member_count" FROM "attendance" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "a_count" ON "a_count".link_to_event = "e".event_id ORDER BY "e".event_name ASC, "e".event_date ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT TRIM(SPLIT_PART("e".expense_description, ',', "n".n)) AS "item_name", COUNT(*) AS "times_bought" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id CROSS JOIN (SELECT 1 AS "n" UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4) AS "n" WHERE "m".first_name = 'Sacha' AND "m".last_name = 'Harrison' AND TRIM(SPLIT_PART("e".expense_description, ',', "n".n)) <> '' GROUP BY TRIM(SPLIT_PART("e".expense_description, ',', "n".n)) ORDER BY item_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "x".full_name, "x".kind_count, "x".total_spending FROM (SELECT "m".first_name || ' ' || "m".last_name AS "full_name", (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT TRIM(LOWER(SPLIT_PART("e2".expense_description, ',', "n".n)))) FROM "expense" AS "e2" CROSS JOIN (SELECT 1 AS "n" UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3) AS "n" WHERE "e2".link_to_member = "m".member_id AND "e2".expense_date >= '2019-10-01' AND "e2".expense_date < '2019-12-01' AND TRIM(SPLIT_PART("e2".expense_description, ',', "n".n)) <> '') AS "kind_count", SUM("e".cost::NUMERIC) AS "total_spending" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "e" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "e".expense_date >= '2019-10-01' AND "e".expense_date < '2019-12-01' GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name) AS "x" WHERE "x".kind_count = (SELECT MAX("y".kind_count) FROM (SELECT "e3".link_to_member, COUNT(DISTINCT TRIM(LOWER(SPLIT_PART("e3".expense_description, ',', "n2".n)))) AS "kind_count" FROM "expense" AS "e3" CROSS JOIN (SELECT 1 AS "n" UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3) AS "n2" WHERE "e3".expense_date >= '2019-10-01' AND "e3".expense_date < '2019-12-01' AND TRIM(SPLIT_PART("e3".expense_description, ',', "n2".n)) <> '' GROUP BY "e3".link_to_member) AS "y") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "m".link_to_major) AS "number_of_majors" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "major" AS "j" ON "m".link_to_major = "j".major_id WHERE "j".department = 'Political Science Department' LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".colour, COUNT(*) AS "hero_count", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS "rank" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".eye_colour_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "c".colour <> 'No Colour' GROUP BY "c".colour ORDER BY hero_count DESC, "c".colour ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "s".superhero_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "sp".power_name = 'Super Strength' ORDER BY "s".superhero_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "neutral_percentage", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral' AND "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS "neutral_marvel_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN marvel_count > dc_count THEN 'Marvel Comics' WHEN dc_count > marvel_count THEN 'DC Comics' ELSE 'Tie' END AS "publisher", ABS(marvel_count - dc_count) AS "difference" FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS "marvel_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') AS "dc_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name IN ('Marvel Comics', 'DC Comics')) AS "counts" LIMIT 501
SELECT "s".superhero_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".eye_colour_id WHERE "s".height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190 AND "c".colour = 'No Colour' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "s".height_cm BETWEEN 150 AND 180 LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".full_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Strength' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT MAX("ha2".attribute_value) FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "a2".attribute_name = 'Strength') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND "s".full_name <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name, "c".colour, "p".publisher_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".eye_colour_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "h" ON "h".id = "s".hair_colour_id AND "h".colour = "c".colour INNER JOIN "colour" AS "sk" ON "sk".id = "s".skin_colour_id AND "sk".colour = "c".colour LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "c".colour <> 'No Colour' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour = 'Blue') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') > COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') THEN 'DC Comics' WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') > COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') THEN 'Marvel Comics' ELSE 'Tie' END AS "publisher", ABS(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics')) AS "difference" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics') LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("s".height_cm) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0 AND "s".id IN (SELECT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" WHERE "hp".power_id NOT IN (SELECT "dc_hp".power_id FROM "hero_power" AS "dc_hp" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "dc" ON "dc".id = "dc_hp".hero_id INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "dc_p" ON "dc_p".id = "dc".publisher_id WHERE "dc_p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "dc_hp".power_id IS NOT NULL)) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "power_count" FROM (SELECT "hp".power_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "hs".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hs" INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "strength" ON "strength".id = "hs".power_id WHERE "strength".power_name = 'Super Strength') AS "strength_heroes" ON "strength_heroes".hero_id = "hp".hero_id GROUP BY "hp".power_id HAVING COUNT("strength_heroes".hero_id) > 0 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT("strength_heroes".hero_id)) AS "qualifying_powers" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 1) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".skin_colour_id WHERE "c".colour ILIKE 'green' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "a".alignment NOT IN ('Good', 'Bad') OR "a".alignment IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "sp".power_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id) AS "hero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '-' GROUP BY "sp".id, "sp".power_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id) = (SELECT MAX(power_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "s2".id) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p2" ON "p2".id = "s2".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp2" ON "hp2".hero_id = "s2".id WHERE "p2".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s2".full_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("s2".full_name) <> '' AND TRIM("s2".full_name) <> '-' GROUP BY "hp2".power_id) AS "counts") ORDER BY "sp".power_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 AND "ha".attribute_value IN (SELECT "ha2".attribute_value FROM "superhero" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" ON "ha2".hero_id = "s2".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "s2".superhero_name = 'Abomination' AND "a2".attribute_name = 'Intelligence') LIMIT 501

SELECT "g".gender, COUNT("q".id) AS "superhero_count" FROM "gender" AS "g" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "s".id, "s".gender_id FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".hair_colour_id WHERE "c".colour = 'Blue' AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" WHERE "hp".hero_id = "s".id) >= 10) AS "q" ON "q".gender_id = "g".id WHERE "g".gender IN ('Male', 'Female') GROUP BY "g".gender ORDER BY "g".gender ASC LIMIT 501
