SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg))::BIGINT AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Strength' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 AND "ha".attribute_value IN (SELECT "hulk_ha".attribute_value FROM "superhero" AS "hulk" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "hulk_ha" ON "hulk_ha".hero_id = "hulk".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "hulk_a" ON "hulk_a".id = "hulk_ha".attribute_id WHERE "hulk".superhero_name = 'Hulk' AND "hulk_a".attribute_name = 'Strength') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) AS "superpower_count" FROM (SELECT id, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height_cm DESC) AS "height_rank" FROM "superhero" WHERE height_cm IS NOT NULL AND height_cm > 0) AS "ranked" LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "ranked".id WHERE "ranked".height_rank <= 10 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "character_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id WHERE ("s".race_id IS NULL OR "r".id IS NULL OR "r".race IS NULL OR "r".race = '-') AND "s".publisher_id IN (SELECT "a".publisher_id FROM "superhero" AS "a" WHERE "a".superhero_name = 'A-Bomb') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("power_counts".power_count), 2) AS "average_superpowers_per_hero" FROM (SELECT "s".id, COUNT("hp".power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "r".race = 'God / Eternal' AND "g".gender = 'Male' GROUP BY "s".id) AS "power_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("portfolio".power_count), 1) AS "average_superpowers" FROM (SELECT "hp".hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "shared".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "shared" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "cryo_holder_power" ON "cryo_holder_power".power_id = "shared".power_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "cryo" ON "cryo".hero_id = "cryo_holder_power".hero_id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "cryo".power_id WHERE "sp".power_name = 'Cryokinesis') AS "eligible" ON "eligible".hero_id = "hp".hero_id GROUP BY "hp".hero_id) AS "portfolio" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("dc".weight_kg)) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "dc" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "dp" ON "dp".id = "dc".publisher_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "marvel".eye_colour_id FROM "superhero" AS "marvel" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "mp" ON "mp".id = "marvel".publisher_id WHERE "mp".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS "shared" ON "shared".eye_colour_id = "dc".eye_colour_id WHERE "dp".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "dc".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "dc".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm), 1) FROM "superhero" AS "s" WHERE "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0 AND "s".race_id IN (SELECT "a".race_id FROM "superhero" AS "a" WHERE "a".superhero_name = 'A-Bomb') LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("s".weight_kg) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" WHERE "s".race_id IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "superhero" AS "other" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "other".gender_id WHERE "other".race_id = "s".race_id AND "g".gender = 'Female') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "publisher_count" FROM "publisher" AS "p" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "s".height_cm > 200 AND "p".publisher_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("p".publisher_name) <> '' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good' AND "p".publisher_name <> 'DC Comics' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 1) AS "average_weight_kg", COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "hero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "h" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "b" ON "b".publisher_id = "h".publisher_id AND "b".superhero_name = 'Blackwulf' WHERE "h".id IN (SELECT "h2".id FROM "superhero" AS "h2" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "other" ON "other".eye_colour_id = "h2".eye_colour_id AND "other".publisher_id <> "h2".publisher_id) LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".race, COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id WHERE "r".race IS NOT NULL AND "r".race <> '-' AND "s".publisher_id IN (SELECT publisher_id FROM "superhero" WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler') GROUP BY "r".id, "r".race HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "superhero" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r2" ON "r2".id = "s2".race_id WHERE "r2".race IS NOT NULL AND "r2".race <> '-' AND "s2".publisher_id IN (SELECT publisher_id FROM "superhero" WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler') GROUP BY "r2".id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("ha".attribute_value), 1) AS "average_intelligence" FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "sp".power_name IN ('Super Speed', 'Death Touch')) AS "powered" ON "powered".hero_id = "ha".hero_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND "ha".attribute_value IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN "g".gender = 'Male' THEN "p".power_count END), 2) AS "male_average", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN "g".gender = 'Female' THEN "p".power_count END), 2) AS "female_average" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "hero_power" GROUP BY hero_id) AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COALESCE("hp".power_count, 0) AS "power_count") AS "p" WHERE "g".gender IN ('Male', 'Female') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '-' AND TRIM("s".full_name) ~ '[^[:space:]]+[[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]+' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(NULLIF("s".height_cm, 0)), 2) AS "average_height_cm", ROUND(AVG(NULLIF("s".weight_kg, 0)), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".skin_colour_id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Bad' AND "c".colour = 'Green' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(NULLIF("s".height_cm, 0)), 1) AS "average_height_cm", ROUND(AVG(NULLIF("s".weight_kg, 0)), 1) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'George Lucas' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("h".height_cm), 1) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "h" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "target_power" ON "target_power".power_id = "hp".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "target" ON "target".id = "target_power".hero_id WHERE "target".superhero_name = '3-D Man') AS "shared" ON "shared".hero_id = "h".id WHERE "h".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "h".height_cm <> 0 AND "h".superhero_name <> '3-D Man' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".skin_colour_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "p" ON "p".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Bad' AND "c".colour = 'Green' AND "p".power_name = 'Flight' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT hero_id FROM "hero_power") AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'George Lucas' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' AND "a".alignment = 'Good' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) AS "superpower_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Male' AND "s".weight_kg > 0 AND "s".weight_kg < 70 LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".colour FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".hair_colour_id WHERE "r".race = 'Human' AND "s".height_cm > 0 ORDER BY "s".height_cm ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT MAX(power_count) AS "largest_number_of_superpowers" FROM (SELECT "s".id, COUNT(DISTINCT "sp".power_name) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id LEFT JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "s".weight_kg = (SELECT MIN(weight_kg) FROM "superhero" WHERE weight_kg > 0) GROUP BY "s".id) AS "lightest_heroes" LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name, "s".full_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Speed' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT MAX("ha2".attribute_value) FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "a2".attribute_name = 'Speed') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT "eyes".colour AS "eye_colour", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "hair".colour <> 'Brown') AS "hero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "h" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "eyes" ON "eyes".id = "h".eye_colour_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "hair" ON "hair".id = "h".hair_colour_id GROUP BY "eyes".id, "eyes".colour HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "hair".colour = 'Brown') > 0 ORDER BY hero_count DESC, "eyes".colour ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".alignment = 'Good' THEN "s".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" WHERE "s".superhero_name <> '3-D Man' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 AND "s".id IN (SELECT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "target_hp" ON "target_hp".power_id = "hp".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "target" ON "target".id = "target_hp".hero_id WHERE "target".superhero_name = '3-D Man') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour = 'No Colour') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour = 'Blue') AS "difference" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".eye_colour_id WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NULL OR "s".weight_kg = 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'M' AND "l".ua > 8.0 THEN "p".id END)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".ua > 6.5 THEN "p".id END), 0) AS "male_to_female_ratio" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".alb)::NUMERIC, 4) AS "average_alb" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".plt > 400 AND "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".tg >= 200 AND "p".birthday < DATE '1976-10-09' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".glu >= 180 AND "l"."T-CHO" < 250 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "age" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".hct >= 52) >= 2 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 2) AS "female_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday < DATE '1971-10-09' AND "l".pt >= 14 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".description IS NULL AND "l".crp LIKE '%+%' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1930-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1941-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT "l"."T-BIL", "l".date, "p".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::NUMERIC END = (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN rnp::NUMERIC END) FROM "laboratory") AND "l"."T-BIL" = (SELECT MAX("T-BIL") FROM "laboratory" WHERE CASE WHEN rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN rnp::NUMERIC END = (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN rnp::NUMERIC END) FROM "laboratory")) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1960-01-01' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp = 'negative' THEN FALSE ELSE "l".rnp::NUMERIC > 10 END) LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::NUMERIC END AS "anti-RNP titer" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "s" ON "s".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "s".ssa IS NOT NULL AND "s".ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0') AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::NUMERIC END = (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN "l2".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l2".rnp::NUMERIC END) FROM "patient" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l2" ON "l2".id = "p2".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "s2" ON "s2".id = "p2".id WHERE "p2".admission = '-' AND "s2".ssa IS NOT NULL AND "s2".ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0')) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM (SELECT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'MCTD' GROUP BY "p".id HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN "l".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 THEN 1 END) > 0 AND COUNT(CASE WHEN CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::NUMERIC > 5 ELSE FALSE END THEN 1 END) > 0) AS "eligible_patients" LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, ROUND(AVG((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".date) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_laboratory_test_dates" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT id, date, dna FROM (SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l".dna, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CAST("l".dna AS NUMERIC) DESC) AS "ranking" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission = '+' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL) AS "ranked" WHERE ranking = 1 ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".admission, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::NUMERIC > 16 ELSE FALSE END GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY "p".admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "h" ON "h".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id WHERE ("h".hct <= 29 OR "h".hct >= 52) AND CASE WHEN "r".rnp = 'negative' THEN NULL ELSE CAST("r".rnp AS NUMERIC) END > 16 LIMIT 501
SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(rnp AS NUMERIC) END) AS "highest_anti_rnp" FROM "laboratory" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "n".id IS NOT NULL) AS "had normal platelet result", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "n".id IS NULL) AS "never had normal platelet result" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE plt > 100 AND plt < 400) AS "n" ON "n".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis IN ('RA, SJS', 'SJS, RA', 'RA, SJS, SLE susp') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".tp::NUMERIC - 8.5), 3) AS "average_deviation" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "examination" WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%') AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".tp > 8.5 LIMIT 501
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE birthday >= DATE '1960-01-01') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ILIKE 'psoriatic arthritis' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".alb < 3.5 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::NUMERIC > 64 THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".rnp = 'negative' OR "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "p".id END), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(1999 - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)) AS "average_age_years" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN "p".id END) AS "women", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN "p".id END) AS "men" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::NUMERIC > 32 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l"."date") - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p"."birthday")) AS "youngest_age" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::NUMERIC >= 64 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT("l".id) AS "total_laboratory_tests", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "l".id IS NULL) AS "patients_with_no_laboratory_tests" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE 'Psoriatic arthritis' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "id") AS "patient_count" FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1998-01-01' AND "thrombosis" > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".symptoms FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "e".thrombosis > 0 AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL AND "p".diagnosis ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]])SLE([^[:alnum:]]|$)' AND "p".diagnosis !~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]])SLE[[:space:]]+susp' GROUP BY "e".symptoms ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "e".symptoms ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SLE susp%' THEN id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT id), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "examination" WHERE thrombosis > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e".first_examination - "p"."First Date")) AS "average_delay_days" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id, MIN("Examination Date") AS "first_examination" FROM "examination" GROUP BY id) AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission LIKE '%+%' AND "p"."First Date" IS NOT NULL AND "e".first_examination IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND "l".date >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1995-01-01' AND "l".got < 60 GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".ldh > 600 AND "l".ldh < 800 AND "l"."U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN "p".id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN "p".id END) AS "women_minus_men" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'RA' AND "l".un < 30 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patients_with_high_creatinine", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "total_patients", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) / COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id AND "l".cre >= 1.5 WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".admission, "p".id, "l"."T-CHO" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l"."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("l2"."T-CHO") FROM "patient" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l2" ON "l2".id = "p2".id WHERE "p2".admission = "p".admission) ORDER BY "p".admission ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "l".id, CASE WHEN "l".rnp = 'negative' THEN 0 ELSE CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER) END AS "anti-RNP level" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p"."First Date" >= '1991-01-01' AND "p"."First Date" < '1992-01-01' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp = 'negative' THEN 0 ELSE CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER) END = (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN "l2".rnp = 'negative' THEN 0 ELSE CAST("l2".rnp AS INTEGER) END) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p2" ON "l2".id = "p2".id WHERE "p2"."First Date" >= '1991-01-01' AND "p2"."First Date" < '1992-01-01' AND "l2".rnp IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501
SELECT AVG(hct) AS "average_hematocrit" FROM "laboratory" WHERE date >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND date < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000') AND hct IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "p".admission = '+') AS "admitted", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "p".admission = '-') AS "outpatient" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'SLE' AND "l"."U-PRO" IN ('30', '100', '300', '+1(30)', '+2(100)', '>=300', '>=1000') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id AND "l".ra IN ('-', '+-') LEFT JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id AND ("e".kct = '+' OR "e".rvvt = '+' OR "e".lac = '+') WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "e".id IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "latest_sample", MAX(CASE WHEN sc170 IS NOT NULL THEN date END) AS "latest_sc170" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id) AS "latest" ON "latest".id = "p".id AND "l".date = "latest".latest_sc170 WHERE "latest".latest_sample > DATE '1997-01-01' AND "l".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "s" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "u" ON "u".id = "s".id WHERE "s".ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0') AND "u"."U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', '0', 'negative', 'none') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND CASE WHEN "l".dna ~ '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)[[:space:]]*$' THEN CAST("l".dna AS NUMERIC) < 8 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission <> '-' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".alp >= 300) LIMIT 501
SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::NUMERIC END) AS "highest_anti_rnp" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".cre < 1.5 LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE "p".sex WHEN 'F' THEN 'female' WHEN 'M' THEN 'male' END AS "sex", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND "l".hgb < 7.0 GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT id, date, rnp FROM "laboratory" WHERE got >= 60 AND CASE WHEN rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN rnp::NUMERIC END = (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN rnp::NUMERIC END) FROM "laboratory" WHERE got >= 60) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1980-01-01' AND ("l".fg < 150 OR "l".fg > 450 OR "l"."U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "patient_group", COUNT("l".ldh) AS "measurement_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id AND "l".ldh < 500 WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patients_with_laboratory_result", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l"."T-BIL" >= 2.0 THEN "p".id END) AS "patients_with_elevated_total_bilirubin" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IS NULL OR TRIM("p".sex) = '' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission LIKE '+%' AND "p".birthday >= DATE '1945-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1990-01-01' AND "e"."ANA Pattern" = 'P' LIMIT 501

SELECT "q".id, "q".sex, "q".highest_rnp FROM (SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, MAX(CASE WHEN "l".rnp <> 'negative' THEN CAST("l".rnp AS BIGINT) END) AS "highest_rnp", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY MAX(CASE WHEN "l".rnp <> 'negative' THEN CAST("l".rnp AS BIGINT) END) DESC NULLS LAST) AS "ranking" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' GROUP BY "p".id, "p".sex HAVING MIN("l".hgb) < 10) AS "q" WHERE "q".ranking = 1 AND "q".highest_rnp IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".date = (SELECT MIN("l2".date) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" WHERE "l2".id = "l".id) AND "l".got < 60 AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::NUMERIC > 10 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "l".date, "l"."U-PRO" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "l".date IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "newer" WHERE "newer".id = "l".id AND "newer"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "newer".date > "l".date) LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".cpk < 250 AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::NUMERIC > 4 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "l".id WHERE CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::NUMERIC > 0 ELSE FALSE END AND "e".thrombosis = 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".birthday AS "Birthday" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE CASE WHEN rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN rnp::NUMERIC >= 16 ELSE FALSE END) AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id WHERE "l".gpt < 60 GROUP BY "p".id, "p".birthday ORDER BY MAX("l".gpt) DESC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".pt < 14 AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::NUMERIC >= 16 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE("l".date, "p".birthday)) AS "age", "p".diagnosis FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission = '+' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CAST("l".dna AS NUMERIC) DESC, "l".date ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]_])SLE([^[:alnum:]_]|$)' AND "p".diagnosis !~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]_])SLE[[:space:]]+susp' AND "l"."T-BIL" >= 1.2 ORDER BY "p".sex ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "care_setting", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::NUMERIC >= 4 ELSE FALSE END) AS "patients_with_result_at_least_4", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) - COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::NUMERIC >= 4 ELSE FALSE END) AS "patients_with_no_such_result" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".birthday <= DATE '1976-10-09' AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY care_setting ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND (SELECT "l".igg FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".igg IS NOT NULL AND "l".date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".date DESC LIMIT 1) >= 2000 LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".diagnosis, "l".dna AS "highest anti-DNA result" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL AND "l".dna::NUMERIC = (SELECT MAX("l2".dna::NUMERIC) FROM "patient" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l2" ON "l2".id = "p2".id WHERE "p2".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "l2".dna IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "care_setting", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "l".igg > 900 AND "l".igg < 2000) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, igg FROM "laboratory" WHERE igg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id ASC, date DESC NULLS LAST) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY "p".admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') - COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') AS "difference" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date = (SELECT MAX("l2".date) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" WHERE "l2".id = "l".id) AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::NUMERIC >= 32 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "latest".id) AS "patient_count" FROM (SELECT "l".id, "l".rnp, "l".cpk, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "l".id ORDER BY "l".date DESC NULLS LAST) AS "measurement_rank" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL) AS "latest" WHERE "latest".measurement_rank = 1 AND CASE WHEN "latest".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST("latest".rnp AS NUMERIC) > 64 ELSE FALSE END AND "latest".cpk < 250 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission = '+') AS "inpatients", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission = '-') AS "outpatients", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission = '+') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission IN ('+', '-')), 0), 2) AS "inpatient_percentage" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]_])SLE([^[:alnum:]_]|$)' AND diagnosis !~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]_])SLE[[:space:]]+susp([^[:alnum:]_]|$)' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "u" ON "u".id = "p".id WHERE "l".ldh >= 500 AND "u"."U-PRO" IN ('100', '300', '+2(100)', '>=300', '>=1000') ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" WHERE sex = 'F' AND "First Date" >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "First Date" < DATE '1999-01-01' AND admission LIKE '+%' LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".symptoms, "p".diagnosis FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "e".diagnosis ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]])SLE([^[:alnum:]]|$)' AND "e".diagnosis !~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]])SLE[[:space:]]+susp([^[:alnum:]]|$)' AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("e".symptoms) <> '' AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "p".birthday DESC, "p".id ASC, "e"."Examination Date" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

SELECT diagnosis FROM "patient" WHERE "First Date" >= DATE '1998-02-15' AND "First Date" < DATE '1998-03-01' AND admission IN ('+', '+(') AND birthday IS NOT NULL ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE("First Date", birthday)) DESC, id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG("aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average anti-cardiolipin IgM" FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1993-10-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1993-11-01' AND diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SLE susp%' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ILIKE 'psoriatic arthritis' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".gpt >= 60) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".admission, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count", ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))), 1) AS "average_completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rbc < 3.5) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY "p".admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "number_of_patients" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e"."aCL IgM"::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average anti-cardiolipin IgM concentration" FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]_])SJS([^[:alnum:]_]|$)' AND "p".diagnosis !~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]_])SJS[[:space:]]+susp([^[:alnum:]_]|$)' AND "e"."aCL IgM" <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "e".diagnosis ~* '(^|,)[[:space:]]*SjS[[:space:]]*(,|$)' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rnp IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "sm" ON "sm".id = "p".id AND "sm".sm IN ('negative', '0') INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "protein" ON "protein".id = "p".id AND "protein"."U-PRO" IN ('30', '100', '300', '+1(30)', '+2(100)', '>=1000', '>=300') INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id AND "e".thrombosis = 0 LEFT JOIN "examination" AS "other" ON "other".id = "p".id AND ("other".thrombosis <> 0 OR "other".thrombosis IS NULL) WHERE "other".id IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "a" ON "a".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND ("r".rbc <= 3.5 OR "r".rbc >= 6.0) AND CASE WHEN "a".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST("a".rnp AS NUMERIC) > 0 ELSE FALSE END GROUP BY "p".id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))), 1) AS "average_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IN ('64', '256')) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday <= DATE '2026-10-09' AND "p".birthday > DATE '1956-10-09' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".wbc > 3.5 AND "l".wbc < 9.0 AND ("l".fg <= 150 OR "l".fg >= 450) AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST("l".rnp AS NUMERIC) > 15 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "women_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1936-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1957-01-01' AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".cpk >= 250) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1987-01-01' AND "l".date >= "p".birthday AND "l".date < "p".birthday + INTERVAL '50 years' AND "l".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND "l"."U-PRO" IN ('1', '2', '3', '4', '30', '100', '300', '%%', '+1(30)', '+2(100)', '>=1000', '>=300', 'TR') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(oxygen_count), 4) AS "average_oxygen_atoms_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT("a".atom_id) AS "oxygen_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type = '-') AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "a".element = 'o' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "molecule_oxygen_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) AS "average_single_bonds_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "single_bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MIN(element_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "element_count" FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m2" ON "m2".molecule_id = "a2".molecule_id WHERE "m2".label = '-' GROUP BY "a2".element) AS "counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'i' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "iodine_atoms", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 's' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "sulfur_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "a".element IN ('i', 's') AND "b".bond_type = '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "a".element = 'f')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "molecule" AS "m" WHERE "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' WHEN "m".label = '-' THEN 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".molecule_id = 'TR010' GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id, "b".molecule_id, "b".bond_type FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE ("a1".element = 'p' AND "a2".element = 'n') OR ("a1".element = 'n' AND "a2".element = 'p') LIMIT 501
SELECT DISTINCT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "connected" AS "c" WHERE "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type = '#') AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "atom" WHERE element IN ('p', 'br')) AS "x" ON "x".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'cl') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS "percentage" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type = '-') AS "b" ON "a".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'h')::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "fraction", "m".label FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".molecule_id = 'TR006' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "b".molecule_id IS NULL AND "m".label = '+' THEN 1 WHEN "b".molecule_id IS NULL AND "m".label = '-' THEN -1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "single_bond_difference", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "b".molecule_id IS NOT NULL AND "m".label = '+' THEN 1 WHEN "b".molecule_id IS NOT NULL AND "m".label = '-' THEN -1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "other_molecules_difference" FROM "molecule" AS "m" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type <> '-' OR bond_type IS NULL) AS "b" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "carbon_carbon_double_bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".bond_type = '=' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' LIMIT 501

SELECT element, ROUND(100.0 * total_element_atoms / total_atoms, 2) AS "percentage" FROM (SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS "total_element_atoms", SUM(bonded) AS "bonded_atoms", SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS "total_atoms", MAX(SUM(bonded)) OVER () AS "max_bonded_atoms" FROM (SELECT "a".atom_id, "a".element, CASE WHEN COUNT("c".bond_id) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "bonded" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id WHERE "m".label = '+' GROUP BY "a".atom_id, "a".element) AS "atoms" GROUP BY element) AS "element_counts" WHERE bonded_atoms = max_bonded_atoms AND bonded_atoms > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' WHEN "m".label = '-' THEN 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic", COUNT("b".bond_id) AS "multiple_bonds" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') WHERE "a".atom_id = 'TR041_10' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' THEN "b".bond_id END) AS "bond_count" FROM "bond" AS "b" LEFT JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('-', '=', '#') GROUP BY "b".bond_type ORDER BY CASE "b".bond_type WHEN '-' THEN 1 WHEN '=' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) AS "count" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id WHERE "a".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "neighbor".atom_id) AS "atom_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "sulfur" ON "sulfur".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "sulfur".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "neighbor" ON "neighbor".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "sulfur".element = 's' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id, "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN (SELECT element FROM "atom" GROUP BY element HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) = 1) AS "unique_elements" ON "unique_elements".element = "a".element WHERE "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) AS "molecule_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') WHERE "a".element = 'n' AND "a".molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT "a2".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c2" ON "c2".atom_id = "a2".atom_id OR "c2".atom_id2 = "a2".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b2" ON "b2".bond_id = "c2".bond_id WHERE "a2".element = 'n' AND "b2".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "m".label = '+') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "carcinogenic_percent", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "m".label = '-') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "non_carcinogenic_percent" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type = '#') AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label IN ('+', '-') LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "atom" AS "other" WHERE "other".element = "a".element AND "other".molecule_id <> "a".molecule_id) GROUP BY "m".molecule_id ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(b.carbon_touching_bonds, 0) DESC, a.number_of_atoms DESC, m.molecule_id ASC) AS rank_position, m.molecule_id, m.label AS carcinogenicity_label, a.number_of_atoms, COALESCE(b.number_of_bonds, 0) AS number_of_bonds, a.number_of_carbon_atoms, a.number_of_chlorine_atoms, COALESCE(b.carbon_touching_bonds, 0) AS carbon_touching_bonds, COALESCE(b.multiple_bonds, 0) AS multiple_bonds FROM molecule m JOIN (SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS number_of_atoms, SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS number_of_carbon_atoms, SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS number_of_chlorine_atoms FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0) a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT bo.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS number_of_bonds, SUM(CASE WHEN cb.bond_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carbon_touching_bonds, SUM(CASE WHEN bo.bond_type IN ('=', '#') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multiple_bonds FROM bond bo LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT co.bond_id FROM connected co JOIN atom at ON at.atom_id = co.atom_id OR at.atom_id = co.atom_id2 WHERE at.element = 'c') cb ON cb.bond_id = bo.bond_id GROUP BY bo.molecule_id) b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id ORDER BY rank_position

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "h" ON "h".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "y" ON "y".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "h".element = 'h' AND "y".element = 'y' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("a".bond_count), 2) AS "average_bonds" FROM (SELECT "atom".atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "connected".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "atom" LEFT JOIN "connected" ON "connected".atom_id = "atom".atom_id WHERE "atom".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "atom".atom_id) AS "a" LIMIT 501

SELECT "other".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "carbon" ON "carbon".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "other" ON "other".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') AND "carbon".element = 'c' GROUP BY "other".element LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "bond_count", COUNT(DISTINCT (LEAST("a1".element, "a2".element), GREATEST("a1".element, "a2".element))) AS "element_pair_count", "m".label FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".molecule_id = 'TR377' AND "b".bond_type IN ('-', '=') GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY bond_count DESC, "b".bond_type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "m".molecule_id FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "a".element IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb', 'mg', 'li') AND "b".bond_type = '-' ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "a".element, COUNT("s".atom_id) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "a2".atom_id FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a2".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a2".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id GROUP BY "a2".atom_id HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN "b".bond_type = '-' THEN 1 END) > 0 AND COUNT(CASE WHEN "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') THEN 1 END) = 0) AS "s" ON "s".atom_id = "a".atom_id GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) AS "molecule_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".element IN (SELECT DISTINCT "a2".element FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a2".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#') GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501
